answer: What keeps this honest is keystroke plus content combined proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 110 POA of exposure, so 379 aliases carry 41690 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One karst of signal, one wharf of cost, one saffron of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
